reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
I got it to try it. I tried it on one of my husky tomato plants just to see if it would be accurate or not. Needless to say on my 2 star rating is it wasn’t. 

I took multiple photos, tried different angles and close ups a good 5 times to see if it would tell me the correct plant, and it kept telling me my husky cherry tomatoes were a poisonous Christmas tomato plant. Lol. 

So, after the 5th go round, I gave up. It’s a cool concept which is why it got above a one star, but it’s good for nothing until it can actually identify the correct plant. I wouldn’t pay for it.
